parsed.root_cause: The Kubernetes scheduler is unable to place new pods because the cluster nodes are exhausted by control-plane taints and insufficient resources to satisfy pod affinity/selector requirements.
evidence: KubeScheduler has disappeared from Prometheus target discovery indicating scheduler instability or failure.
Kubernetes event FailedScheduling shows '0/5 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector.'
PendingPodsDetected alert confirms 2 pods are stuck in pending state.
CPUThrottlingHigh alerts on the frontend container suggest resource contention contributing to scheduling failures.
